interval.assumption: each retained check outcome is treated as an independent Bernoulli trial; checks sharing a prompt or seed are correlated, so intervals are approximate

reference_variability.limitation: Observed sample repeatability; not a statistical guarantee or a quality score.

performance.label: Client-side request latency (includes network)
performance.limitations: Client-side wall time per sequential request, including the network, load balancer and any concurrent traffic on the server. Descriptive only; not a policy target.

methodology.aggregation: arithmetic mean across complete measured request calls
methodology.isolation: none: remote server state is not reset between trials
